name: OmaPen
author: stempelv
description: "Help me write" for Omarchy: rewrite whatever you have selected, or whatever you type into the panel, with the coding agent Omarchy already knows about

barWidget.description: Rewrite selected or typed text with the system AI agent

schema.label: Agent
schema.description: System default follows the agent picked in Setup > Default agent, which is the one already installed and signed in. Naming an agent here uses that one instead, and fails plainly when it is not installed.

schema.label: Model
schema.description: Passed to the agent as its model flag. Empty picks a small fast model per agent (claude: haiku, codex: gpt-5.6-luna at minimal reasoning, gemini: gemini-3.7-flash), which is the right size for a rewrite. Name a model here to override that.

schema.label: What to do with the result
schema.description: Show in panel puts the rewrite in front of you with a copy button and leaves your document untouched. Replace the selection focuses the window the text came from and pastes over it, which is faster and is the version you want once you trust it.

schema.label: Read the focused window
schema.description: Asks the window in front of you what it has, by sending it Ctrl+C and, when nothing is selected there, Ctrl+A Ctrl+C for the whole field. This is what keeps the panel on the sentence you are looking at rather than on a selection left over from an hour ago. Off falls back to the last selection and the clipboard, which is the safer setting if you do not want keystrokes sent anywhere. Terminals are never sent keys either way, since Ctrl+C there means stop, not copy.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Anything wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.
